name: agent-roster-narrow-owners
body: The editing change-set reuses `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` (`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`) and `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (`opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`); each is 1:1 to its one file, so reuse keeps the task set minimal. It adds narrow components for the new reviewer file (`distributed-reviewer-prompt`), the install/embed/upgrade surface (`distributed-agent-install`), and the roster docs (`agent-roster-docs`). `distributed-agent-install` overlaps `solution.component.agent-fs-install-registry` on `rust.apg.install`: coverage is per-solution-node and every in-scope node's `implemented-by` FQN is touched by a task, and the fs-tools component is also implemented-by the unrelated `rust.main_e2e.e2e.suite_installs_node_edge_project_tools_and_retires_spec_invariant`, so reusing it forces a fake task over that untouched test. Overlapping component ownership of one file is established practice (`codebase-navigator-prompt` and `navigator-prompt-guidance` share `codebase-navigator.md`).
